thread:
deploy-bot: Request to enable temporary compatibility flag ff/accept-legacy-sig for gateway to mitigate client-side signature regressions after sdk-js v3.6 rollout. Proposed window: 02:00-05:00 UTC. Affects hosted gateway and signed-token flow. Ticket INF-4902 created.

mira: Can we get a concise failure summary for the advisory? Need numbers for CS and partners.

jon: Canary id canary-sdk-20260324-2. Observed 401 invalid_signature accounting for ~1.8% of requests during canary. Root cause: transpilation change in signing lib in sdk-js v3.6 emitting sha1 header for some legacy builds.

security-bot: Risk note: accepting legacy sha1 signatures increases attack surface slightly. Recommend limiting window and adding telemetry tags so we can audit. Also require that ff auto-expires.

ops-lead: Ops can enable the flag. We'll also suppress autoscaling on the gateway service while flag is live to avoid noisy autoscale. Who will monitor?

mira: I will own comms and customer advisory. Proposed line: "Temporary compatibility mode to accept legacy signatures enabled for limited window; upgrade to sdk-js v3.6.1 when available."

jon: Engineering plan: cut sdk-js v3.6.1 with a transpile fix in ~90m and run a short canary. If canary shows fix, unflag and proceed with staged rollout. If legacy traffic >5% sustained for 10m, publish support banner and extend window.

security-bot: Add telemetry filter legacy_sig and tag requests with X-Compat-Sig=legacy. Ensure logs redact secrets.

ops-lead: Enabling flag now in feature-flag service with auto-expiry at 05:00 UTC. Suppressing autoscaling for duration. Monitoring channel: #eng-oncall.

deploy-bot: Feature flag enabled 02:02 UTC. Initial legacy-sig rate 0.4%. Telemetry: https://telemetry.internal/streams/legacy_sig?c=canary-sdk-20260324-2

mira: Published advisory to #customer-success and linked ticket INF-4902. Draft release note added.

jon: CI for v3.6.1 green. Canary started 03:10 UTC. Preliminary metrics: 401 invalid_signature down to 0.03%. No gateway regressions.

ops-lead: Good. Unflag scheduled for 04:20 UTC pending canary. If regressions reappear, we will re-enable and coordinate longer remediation.

deploy-bot: Flag toggled off 04:18 UTC. Legacy-sig traffic fell to 0.01% as clients upgraded. Feature flag expiry cancelled. Ticket INF-4902 closed with follow-up to remind partners in weekly changelog.
